review.reviewer: Independent visual reviewer; explicitly loaded image_visual role instructions

objective.evidence: Exactly four ascending bars, quarter labels, dollar labels and one turquoise upward-trend arrow are present.

text_facts.evidence: Direct visual inspection on the dark composite reads Q1 $42M, Q2 $51M, Q3 $63M and Q4 $78M. The shared-baseline bar heights are visually consistent with the required proportions: Q1 slightly over half Q4, Q2 about two-thirds, and Q3 about four-fifths.

composition.evidence: Bars share a baseline, labels align above and below their respective bars, and the trend arrow clears the labels. All elements are fully visible and white lettering is legible on the intended dark background.

brand_reference.evidence: Cobalt, bright blue, azure and turquoise progression and the upward revenue narrative correspond to the source. Simpler flat bars and omission of source axes are acceptable prompt-compliant variations.

visual_integrity.evidence: Bar edges and arrow are coherent; text is readable without malformed characters, overlaps or missing marks.

preservation.evidence: Fresh text-only generation; exact source pixels and artwork geometry were not preservation targets.

transparency.evidence: Light and dark composites show clean surrounding and interbar space with no filled plot panel, rectangular backdrop or material broad halo. White labels are intentionally assessed on dark; their low white-background contrast is not a defect.
